title: TOUCAN: Synthesizing 1.5M Tool-Agentic Data from Real-World MCP Environments
authors_zh: Zhangchen Xu、Adriana Meza Soria、Shawn Tan、Anurag Roy、Ashish Sunil Agrawal、Radha Poovendran、Rameswar Panda
paper_type_zh: 真实 MCP 环境合成工具 agent 轨迹数据发布与 SFT 配方
best_for_zh: 关注工具 agent SFT、MCP 轨迹构造、混合评审契约、环境回放与数据审计的研究者
one_line: TOUCAN releases 1,527,259 synthetic task-tool episodes generated through 495 live MCP servers plus a 119,287-row SFT subset, while mixed heuristic/judge labels and mutable remote environments limit correctness guarantees and replay.
TOUCAN 发布 1,527,259 条经 495 个真实 MCP 服务生成的工具 agent 轨迹，并从中筛出 119,287 行 SFT 子集；混合规则与模型评审及可变远程环境限制了任务正确性保证和精确回放。
why: It makes large-scale agent SFT data inspectable from task and tool declarations through calls, observations, filtering labels, and final responses, and shows why real execution, task correctness, historical release fidelity, and executable replay are four different audit claims.
inclusion_reason: TOUCAN exposes a large, concrete agent-data contract in which synthetic MCP-grounded tasks produce multi-message state-action-tool-response episodes, mixed rule/judge annotations select a 119K SFT subset, and live-service drift sharply separates downloadable historical traces from replayable online environments.

title: Problem
问题
html:
TOUCAN is an arXiv preprint submitted on 2025-10-01. The official evidence used here is arXiv v1, the official Agent Ark repository, and the official Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M release. It addresses a concrete agent-data bottleneck: large tool-use corpora often use simulated outputs or narrow APIs, while collecting episodes against diverse live services is difficult to scale, filter, and audit.

The work belongs in Environment and Agent Trajectory Data because its reusable object is an interactive episode, not merely a prompt-answer pair. A full-release row carries a UUID and subset label; the synthetic question; available and target tool declarations; a serialized multi-message history containing system/tool schemas, user turns, assistant tool calls and arguments, remote tool/function responses, and a final assistant response; task- and response-quality assessments; and MCP metadata. The SFT configuration is a reduced six-column view and omits assessment and metadata columns.

The decision boundary is important. TOUCAN records real responses from live MCP services, but it does not release a normalized environment state, state delta, scalar reward, or task-general predicate proving that the user's end goal was correct. Its mixed feedback contract can establish format compliance, tool-use behavior, target-tool coverage/order, and judge-rated plausibility/completeness; it cannot turn every retained episode into a verified successful trajectory.

The card reaches bilingual screening depth because the paper, appendix, code, release schemas, counts, declared licenses, and principal filters were checked. It remains L3_summary_ready in canonical metadata, and high-assurance reuse is still blocked by unresolved release binding, per-row lineage, exact replay, upstream rights, PII auditing, decontamination, and rejected-sample accounting.

TOUCAN 是一篇于 2025-10-01 提交的 arXiv 预印本。本卡使用的官方证据包括 arXiv v1、Agent Ark 官方仓库和 Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M 官方发布。论文处理一个具体的 agent 数据瓶颈：大规模工具使用语料常依赖模拟输出或狭窄 API，而在多样化真实服务上收集 episode 很难同时做到规模化、过滤与审计。

该工作归入 Environment and Agent Trajectory Data，因为它的可复用对象是交互 episode，而不只是 prompt-answer 对。一个 full-release 行包含 UUID 与 subset label、合成问题、可用/目标工具声明，以及序列化的多消息历史；历史保存 system/tool schema、用户轮次、assistant 工具调用及参数、远程 tool/function response 和最终 assistant response，此外还有任务/响应质量评审与 MCP 元数据。SFT 配置是缩减后的六列视图，不含评审和元数据列。

必须明确其判定边界。TOUCAN 记录真实 MCP 服务的响应，但没有发布规范化 environment state、state delta、标量 reward，也没有证明用户最终目标正确的通用任务谓词。其 mixed 反馈契约可以检查格式合规、工具使用行为、目标工具覆盖/顺序以及模型评审的合理性与完整性，却不能把每个保留 episode 都变成经验证的成功轨迹。

本卡已核对论文、附录、代码、发布 schema、计数、声明的许可证和主要过滤规则，因此达到双语筛选所需的信息深度；canonical metadata 仍保持 L3_summary_ready。高保证复用仍受发布版本绑定、逐行 lineage、精确回放、上游权利、PII 审计、去污染和拒绝样本核算等缺口限制。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
TOUCAN's central contribution is an inspectable pipeline that turns MCP specifications into synthetic tasks, executes agent policies against live remote tools, attaches rule- and judge-based feedback, and publishes both three generator-specific full configurations and a thresholded SFT view.

The mechanism couples four objects that should not be conflated:

  • Task context: specifications from GitHub and Smithery define available tools, while each generated task seeds one to three target tools under single-server, multi-server, or featured-server sampling.
  • Episode: GPT-OSS-120B, Kimi-K2, or Qwen3-32B acts through Qwen-Agent or OpenAI Agents, producing tool calls, live observations, and a final response.
  • Feedback: Kimi-K2 supplies six reasoned 1-5 task scores; public rules check episode shape and at least one meaningful tool response; name-based logic measures target-tool coverage and order; GPT-OSS-120B scores completeness and conciseness from 1 to 5.
  • Training view: hard thresholds and category rebalancing select 119,287 rows for SFT, while the richer full configurations retain quality assessments and MCP metadata.

Feedback is attached at both state/action and full-episode levels, but it is not a universal reward. Kimi-K2 and GPT-OSS-120B can observe the serialized task, trace, and requested quality dimensions; the rule layer can observe messages and tool names. Neither layer has a general gold representation of the user's intended world state, and real tool execution alone does not prove that the final synthesis is correct.

The closest controlled comparison in this atlas is to executable agent benchmarks such as tau2-bench, which TOUCAN uses for downstream evaluation. TOUCAN's primary contribution is instead trainable trajectory construction and release. That distinction matters: benchmark scores are evidence about trained models under those evaluations, not direct validation of every released row or of the judges that selected the SFT subset.

TOUCAN 的核心贡献是一条可检查的流水线：把 MCP specification 转为合成任务，让 agent policy 对真实远程工具执行，附加规则与模型评审反馈，并同时发布三个按生成模型划分的 full config 和一个经过阈值筛选的 SFT 视图。

该机制连接四类不应混为一谈的对象：

  • 任务上下文：来自 GitHub 与 Smithery 的 specification 定义可用工具；每个任务在 single-server、multi-server 或 featured-server 采样下预设一至三个目标工具。
  • Episode：GPT-OSS-120B、Kimi-K2 或 Qwen3-32B 通过 Qwen-Agent 或 OpenAI Agents 行动，产生工具调用、真实 observation 和最终响应。
  • 反馈：Kimi-K2 给出六项带理由的 1–5 分任务评分；公开规则检查 episode 结构及至少一个有意义工具响应；基于名称的逻辑计算目标工具覆盖与顺序；GPT-OSS-120B 对完整性和简洁性给出 1–5 分。
  • 训练视图：硬阈值与类别再平衡筛出 119,287 行用于 SFT，而更丰富的 full config 保留质量评审与 MCP 元数据。

反馈同时附着于 state/action 与完整 episode 层级，但不是通用 reward。Kimi-K2 和 GPT-OSS-120B 能观察序列化任务、轨迹及被要求的质量维度；规则层能观察消息和工具名。两者都没有用户期望世界状态的通用 gold representation，而真实工具执行本身也不能证明最终综合正确。

在本 Atlas 中，最接近的受控对照是 tau2-bench 等可执行 agent benchmark，TOUCAN 把它们用于下游评测；TOUCAN 的主要贡献则是可训练轨迹的构造与发布。这个区别很关键：benchmark 分数只是在相应评测下关于训练后模型的证据，并不是对每条发布数据或 SFT 选择 judge 的直接验证。

title: Method
方法
html:
The core construction is a five-stage pipeline.

  1. MCP onboarding. Crawl roughly 2,800 server specifications from GitHub and Smithery, keep 871 credential-free servers supporting streamable HTTP, then test sampled tools and retain 495 functioning servers exposing more than 2,000 tools. LLM-generated domain labels organize servers but are not a human-verified ontology.
  2. Task synthesis. Mistral-Small, DevStral-Small, GPT-OSS, Kimi-K2, and Qwen3-32B generate tasks under single-server, multi-server, and 25 manually selected featured-server strategies. Reported experiments use at most three target tools. Formatting cleanup and embedding deduplication are applied; public code defaults to cosine-distance threshold 0.1, but the historical production value is not confirmed.
  3. Task review. Kimi-K2 assigns reasoned 1-5 scores for tool-selection difficulty, tool-selection uniqueness, question quality, scenario realism, verifiability, and stability. The judge choice is supported by a 50-example human comparison with reported Pearson correlation 0.264, which is calibration evidence rather than proof of label accuracy.
  4. Live rollout. GPT-OSS-120B, Kimi-K2, and Qwen3-32B execute through Qwen-Agent or OpenAI Agents against remote MCP endpoints. The episode preserves native system/tool declarations, user messages, assistant tool calls, tool/function responses, and a final answer. Exact per-row model/framework pairing, decoding, seed, endpoint revision, retries, and collection time are not exposed.
  5. Trajectory review and packaging. Public rules require an initialized agent, ordinary tool use, at least one meaningful tool response, no assistant error marker, a non-empty final answer, and no exclamation mark in assistant messages. Partial tool failures may remain if another call succeeds. Target-tool coverage and order use substring name matching. GPT-OSS-120B gives 1-5 completeness and conciseness scores. Three extensions then produce irrelevance examples with zero tool calls, persona/constraint diversification with the same target tools, and multi-turn tasks via subquestions or follow-ups.

The three full configurations contain 518,516 Kimi-K2, 457,130 OSS, and 551,613 Qwen3 episodes, totaling 1,527,259. SFT selection requires question quality 5, scenario realism 5, completeness at least 4, conciseness at least 4, and target-tool coverage 1.0, followed by category rebalancing. This yields 119,287 rows, approximately 28.3K core, 40K irrelevance, 15.8K diversified, and 35.2K multi-turn examples. That SFT config is a selected subset, not an additional unique trajectory partition.

The only demonstrated training use is supervised fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, and Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct with the Hermes tool-call template, learning rate 2e-5, two epochs, effective batch size 64, AdamW, DeepSpeed ZeRO-3, and maximum sequence length 32,768. Public runner defaults include temperature 1.0, top-p 1.0, 32,768 maximum tokens, a 90-second item timeout, and ten turns for the OpenAI-agent runner, but the paper does not bind these defaults to the released corpus.

核心构造是一条五阶段流水线。

  1. MCP 接入。从 GitHub 与 Smithery 抓取约 2,800 个 server specification，保留 871 个无需凭据且支持 streamable HTTP 的服务，再测试抽样工具并留下 495 个可用服务，共暴露 2,000 多个工具。LLM 生成的领域标签用于组织服务，但不是经人工验证的 ontology。
  2. 任务合成。Mistral-Small、DevStral-Small、GPT-OSS、Kimi-K2 和 Qwen3-32B 在 single-server、multi-server 与 25 个手工选定 featured-server 策略下生成任务；论文实验最多使用三个目标工具。随后进行格式清理与 embedding 去重；公开代码默认 cosine-distance 阈值为 0.1，但历史生产值未确认。
  3. 任务评审。Kimi-K2 对工具选择难度、工具选择唯一性、问题质量、场景真实性、可验证性和稳定性给出带理由的 1–5 分。judge 选择依据包括 50 个样本的人类对照，报告 Pearson correlation 0.264；这是校准证据，而非标签准确性的证明。
  4. 真实 rollout。GPT-OSS-120B、Kimi-K2 与 Qwen3-32B 通过 Qwen-Agent 或 OpenAI Agents 调用远程 MCP endpoint。episode 保存原生 system/tool 声明、用户消息、assistant 工具调用、tool/function response 和最终答案。逐行模型/framework 配对、解码、seed、endpoint revision、重试与采集时间均未公开。
  5. 轨迹评审与打包。公开规则要求 agent 已初始化、普通样本发生工具调用、至少一个有意义工具响应、没有 assistant error marker、最终答案非空，并且 assistant 消息不含感叹号。若其他调用成功，部分工具失败可以保留。目标工具覆盖率和顺序通过 substring 工具名匹配计算；GPT-OSS-120B 对完整性与简洁性给 1–5 分。之后三种扩展分别构造零工具调用的 irrelevance 样本、保持相同目标工具的 persona/constraint 多样化样本，以及通过子问题或 follow-up 形成的 multi-turn 任务。

三个 full config 分别包含 518,516 条 Kimi-K2、457,130 条 OSS 和 551,613 条 Qwen3 episode，总计 1,527,259。SFT 选择要求问题质量为 5、场景真实性为 5、完整性至少 4、简洁性至少 4、目标工具覆盖率为 1.0，随后进行类别再平衡，得到 119,287 行：约 28.3K core、40K irrelevance、15.8K diversified 和 35.2K multi-turn。该 SFT config 是筛选子集，不是额外的唯一轨迹分区。

论文唯一展示的训练用途是对 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 做 supervised fine-tuning，使用 Hermes tool-call template、2e-5 学习率、两轮训练、effective batch size 64、AdamW、DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 和 32,768 最大序列长度。公开 runner 默认 temperature 1.0、top-p 1.0、32,768 最大 token、单条 90 秒 timeout，OpenAI-agent runner 默认十轮；但论文没有把这些默认值绑定到已发布语料。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The release evidence supports the corpus accounting. At HF revision 0df3cf37f2abefb380370cfb02eabea2a35ae782, Kimi-K2 has 518,516 rows, OSS 457,130, and Qwen3 551,613; these full configurations sum exactly to the paper's 1,527,259 trajectories. HF reports 1,646,546 stored rows only because the same release also hosts the 119,287-row SFT subset as a fourth configuration. Adding that subset to the full configurations double-counts selected rows and must not be reported as 1,646,546 unique trajectories. All four configurations expose only a train split.

The paper reports 567,262 multi-turn conversations. Its SFT subset comprises approximately 28.3K original, 40K irrelevance, 15.8K diversified, and 35.2K multi-turn examples, matching the hosted count after exact row accounting. The richer full schemas expose question and response assessments plus metadata; the six-column SFT schema omits those fields, so downstream users cannot recover every selection signal from the training view alone.

The task judge is only lightly calibrated: the reported Kimi-K2 selection comparison uses 50 human-annotated examples and Pearson correlation 0.264. Public code makes the rule layer auditable and the HF card clarifies that partial tool failures may remain, but neither fact measures end-task correctness. Substring-based target-tool matching is also a weaker signal than semantic or environment-state verification.

Downstream SFT results are positive but should be read narrowly. BFCL V3 overall scores change from 55.10 to 58.26 for Qwen2.5-7B, 57.69 to 65.09 for 14B, and 61.73 to 70.45 for 32B. The paper also reports average gains on tau-bench and tau2-bench and a better model-size/OSR frontier on MCP-Universe. For Qwen2.5-14B, progressive BFCL mixtures score 60.16 for single, 64.74 after irrelevance, 64.56 after diversification, and 65.09 after multi-turn, so intermediate additions are not uniformly monotonic. These author-reported evaluations support the SFT recipe's utility in tested settings; they are not proof that the released data are clean, correctly judged, uncontaminated, licensed at component level, or replayable.

发布证据支持如下语料核算。在 HF revision 0df3cf37f2abefb380370cfb02eabea2a35ae782，Kimi-K2 有 518,516 行、OSS 有 457,130 行、Qwen3 有 551,613 行，三个 full config 精确合计为论文所称的 1,527,259 条轨迹。HF 之所以报告 1,646,546 个存储行，只是因为同一发布还把 119,287 行 SFT 子集作为第四个 config 托管。把该子集与三个 full config 相加会重复计算被选中的行，不能称为 1,646,546 条唯一轨迹。四个配置都只有 train split。

论文报告 567,262 个 multi-turn conversation。SFT 子集由约 28.3K original、40K irrelevance、15.8K diversified 与 35.2K multi-turn 样本构成，精确行数核算后与托管配置一致。信息更丰富的 full schema 公开问题/响应评审与元数据，而六列 SFT schema 省略这些字段，因此下游用户无法仅从训练视图恢复全部选择信号。

任务 judge 的校准较有限：Kimi-K2 选择对照只使用 50 个带人工标注的样本，报告 Pearson correlation 0.264。公开代码使规则层可以审查，HF card 也澄清部分工具失败可以保留，但这两点都没有度量最终任务正确性。基于 substring 的目标工具匹配同样弱于语义验证或 environment-state 验证。

下游 SFT 结果为正，但应窄化解读。BFCL V3 overall score 在 Qwen2.5-7B 上从 55.10 变为 58.26，14B 从 57.69 变为 65.09，32B 从 61.73 变为 70.45。论文还报告 tau-bench 与 tau2-bench 平均结果提升，以及 MCP-Universe 上更好的模型规模/OSR 前沿。对 Qwen2.5-14B，渐进 BFCL mixture 分别为 single 60.16、加入 irrelevance 后 64.74、加入 diversification 后 64.56、加入 multi-turn 后 65.09，可见中间增量并非单调。这些作者报告的评测支持 SFT 配方在已测设置中的效用，但不能证明发布数据干净、评审正确、无污染、组件级权利完备或可精确回放。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
TOUCAN's direction signal is the combination of scale, real MCP execution, heterogeneous community services, explicit task and trajectory review, and a released SFT projection. It operationalizes the path from machine-readable tool specifications to full state-action-observation episodes rather than stopping at static function-call examples or simulated tool outputs. Three extensions also make abstention/irrelevance, persona/constraint variation, and multi-turn interaction part of the same construction system.

The most reusable quality signal is not the phrase “real-world” or a benchmark score. It is the visible feedback contract: Kimi-K2 task dimensions, auditable structural rules, target-tool coverage/order, GPT-OSS-120B response dimensions, and explicit thresholds for the 119,287-row SFT subset. The full configurations preserve these assessments and MCP metadata, allowing offline analysis that the reduced SFT view alone cannot support.

What is not new should remain explicit. Synthetic task generation, LLM-as-judge filtering, supervised fine-tuning, tool-call templates, and benchmark evaluation are established ingredients. Real service calls are not a novel correctness proof, and the paper does not supply a general reward or replayable environment package. The contribution is therefore best treated as a large integrated construction-and-release recipe, not as evidence that mixed heuristics solve agent verification.

Reuse checks should compare source-server and task overlap, tool-name collision behavior, successful versus rejected trajectory retention, and whether downstream claims survive fixed unique-row accounting. The 119,287 SFT rows must remain linked to, rather than counted in addition to, the 1,527,259 full trajectories.

TOUCAN 的方向信号来自规模、真实 MCP 执行、异构社区服务、显式任务/轨迹评审与已发布 SFT 投影的组合。它把 machine-readable 工具 specification 一直转化为完整 state-action-observation episode，而不是停留在静态 function-call 示例或模拟工具输出。三类扩展还把 abstention/irrelevance、persona/constraint 变化与 multi-turn 交互纳入同一构造系统。

最可复用的质量信号不是“real-world”措辞或 benchmark 分数，而是可见的反馈契约：Kimi-K2 任务维度、可审查的结构规则、目标工具覆盖/顺序、GPT-OSS-120B 响应维度，以及 119,287 行 SFT 子集的明确阈值。full config 保留这些评审与 MCP 元数据，支持缩减 SFT 视图本身无法完成的离线分析。

也要明确哪些并不新。合成任务生成、LLM-as-judge 过滤、supervised fine-tuning、tool-call template 与 benchmark 评测都是既有组件。真实服务调用不是新的正确性证明，论文也没有提供通用 reward 或可回放环境包。因此，该贡献更适合作为大规模一体化构造与发布配方，而不是 mixed heuristic 已解决 agent 验证的证据。

复用检查应比较来源服务/任务重叠、工具名碰撞行为、成功与拒绝轨迹保留情况，并确认下游结论在固定唯一行数核算后仍成立。119,287 个 SFT 行必须与 1,527,259 条 full trajectory 保持子集关联，而不能额外相加。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The main limitations are audit and replay boundaries, not merely model accuracy.

  • No general success predicate. The mixed contract checks structure, some tool-response validity, target-tool compliance, and judge-rated quality. It can retain a plausible final answer whose tool output or synthesis is factually wrong. Target-tool matching uses substrings and can collide between similar names or reward seeded-tool compliance over an alternative valid workflow.
  • Truncated failure spectrum. Partial failures can remain when at least one call succeeds, and irrelevance examples deliberately retain zero calls. Ordinary no-tool, all-tool-failure, assistant-error-marker, empty-final, parsing, and other rejected cases are absent. No machine-readable rejection ledger or stage-wise yield is released.
  • Judge uncertainty. Kimi-K2 and GPT-OSS-120B may encode model, style, and domain biases. A 50-example task-judge comparison with correlation 0.264 does not provide per-dimension agreement, false-positive/false-negative rates, adversarial robustness, or calibration of the response judge.
  • Version and lineage gaps. The paper is arXiv v1 from 2025-10-01; the dataset snapshot checked is HF revision 0df3cf3 from 2025-10-04; the code snapshot is GitHub commit a1976de from 2025-12-16 with no tag or release. No manifest binds paper, code, dependencies, model endpoints, MCP metadata, dataset files, or SFT checkpoints. Per-row generator, framework, decoding, seed, retries, filters, server/source commit, endpoint revision, and timestamp are unknown.
  • Replay gap. Historical messages and observations are downloadable, but 495 community MCP services, dependencies, credentials/configuration, mutable world state, reset semantics, endpoint versions, and response fixtures are not frozen. The paper says collection occurred in 2025-06, while the HF card says 2025-06 through 2025-09; per-row timing cannot resolve this discrepancy.
  • Split and contamination gaps. Every config is train-only. No systematic decontamination, near-duplicate accounting, or overlap audit is disclosed for BFCL V3, tau-bench, tau2-bench, MCP-Universe, earlier tool-use corpora, or model pretraining data.
  • Rights and privacy gaps. HF declares Apache-2.0 and the code repository MIT, but no per-server/tool license and attribution manifest establishes rights for community specifications, live tool outputs, embedded third-party content, or generated trajectories. The HF card reports best-effort rule-based PII replacement, without scanner rules, measured recall/precision, consent analysis, a redaction manifest, or residual-content audit.
  • Count interpretation. HF's 1,646,546 stored rows include the 119,287-row SFT subset. Treating all stored rows as independent episodes overstates unique full trajectories by exactly that subset; the correct full total is 1,527,259.

These gaps make the release useful for SFT and historical offline study, but they prevent claims of exact environment replay, complete component-level rights clearance, population-level failure coverage, or leakage-safe benchmark evaluation.

主要限制来自审计与回放边界，而不只是模型准确率。

  • 没有通用成功谓词。mixed 契约检查结构、部分工具响应有效性、目标工具遵从与模型评审质量。它可能保留工具输出或最终综合在事实层面错误、但外观合理的答案。目标工具匹配使用 substring，相似名称可能碰撞，也可能奖励对预设工具的遵从，而不是另一条有效 workflow。
  • 失败谱系被截断。只要至少一次调用成功，部分失败可以保留；irrelevance 样本则有意保留零调用。普通无工具、全部工具失败、assistant error marker、空 final、解析失败及其他拒绝样本都不在发布中，也没有 machine-readable rejection ledger 或逐阶段 yield。
  • Judge 不确定性。Kimi-K2 与 GPT-OSS-120B 可能带来模型、风格和领域偏差。50 个样本、correlation 0.264 的任务 judge 对照没有给出逐维度一致性、false positive/false negative、对抗鲁棒性或 response judge 校准。
  • 版本与 lineage 缺口。论文是 2025-10-01 的 arXiv v1；核对的数据快照是 2025-10-04 的 HF revision 0df3cf3；代码快照是 2025-12-16 的 GitHub commit a1976de，没有 tag 或 release。没有 manifest 绑定论文、代码、依赖、模型 endpoint、MCP 元数据、数据文件和 SFT checkpoint。逐行 generator、framework、解码、seed、重试、过滤、server/source commit、endpoint revision 与 timestamp 均未知。
  • 回放缺口。历史消息和 observation 可下载，但 495 个社区 MCP 服务、依赖、凭据/配置、可变 world state、reset semantics、endpoint version 与 response fixture 没有冻结。论文称数据在 2025-06 采集，HF card 则称 2025-06 至 2025-09；缺少逐行时间，无法消除该矛盾。
  • Split 与污染缺口。所有 config 都只有 train split。没有公开针对 BFCL V3、tau-bench、tau2-bench、MCP-Universe、既有工具使用语料或模型预训练数据的系统性去污染、近重复核算或 overlap audit。
  • 权利与隐私缺口。HF 声明 Apache-2.0，代码仓库声明 MIT，但没有逐服务/工具许可证与归属 manifest 来证明社区 specification、真实工具输出、嵌入的第三方内容和生成轨迹的权利。HF card 报告 best-effort 的规则式 PII replacement，却没有公开 scanner rule、实测 recall/precision、consent 分析、redaction manifest 或残余内容审计。
  • 计数解释。HF 的 1,646,546 个存储行包含 119,287 行 SFT 子集。把所有存储行视为独立 episode，会恰好多算该子集；full trajectory 的正确总数是 1,527,259。

这些缺口不妨碍该发布用于 SFT 与历史离线研究，但阻止了精确环境回放、完整组件级权利清理、总体层面失败覆盖或无泄漏 benchmark 评测等更强结论。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned Environment and Agent Trajectory Data track, TOUCAN is useful because it exposes the episode boundary from task and tool declarations through assistant actions, live observations, final response, selection annotations, and provenance metadata. It supports comparisons among single-server, multi-server, irrelevance, diversified, and multi-turn constructions, and it makes the distinction between downloadable historical traces and replayable environments concrete.

Its demonstrated training use is SFT only. The 119,287-row configuration can be used for tool-agent supervised fine-tuning or distillation-style imitation after row-count, rights, privacy, and contamination checks. The paper does not support relabeling the corpus for RLVR, online environment RL, reward-model training, preference optimization, or process-reward-model training; multi-dimensional judge annotations are filtering signals, not a disclosed scalar reward.

The richer full configurations are also useful for non-training work: analyzing tool-call sequences, partial tool failures, judge/rule disagreement, target-tool compliance, domain mixture, and the information lost in the SFT projection. These are audit and construction studies rather than additional entries in training_use.

A careful reuser should pin HF revision 0df3cf3, keep the 119,287 SFT rows linked to the 1,527,259 full trajectories, explicitly preserve subset_name, tool schemas, messages, assessments, and MCP metadata when available, and isolate irrelevance from ordinary episodes. High-assurance reuse additionally requires a record-level lineage manifest, frozen MCP replay fixtures or a clear offline-only designation, an accepted/rejected ledger, duplicate and benchmark-overlap checks, per-component rights review, and documented PII scanning. Benchmark gains should be independently reproduced without treating them as a substitute for these data checks.

对指定的 Environment and Agent Trajectory Data 方向，TOUCAN 的价值在于公开从任务/工具声明到 assistant action、真实 observation、最终响应、选择标注和 provenance metadata 的 episode 边界。它支持比较 single-server、multi-server、irrelevance、diversified 与 multi-turn 构造，也具体展示了“可下载历史轨迹”与“可回放环境”的区别。

论文展示的训练用途仅为 SFT。在完成行数、权利、隐私与污染检查后，119,287 行配置可用于工具 agent supervised fine-tuning 或蒸馏式 imitation。论文不支持把该语料重新标为 RLVR、在线 environment RL、reward-model training、preference optimization 或 process-reward-model training；多维 judge annotation 是过滤信号，不是已披露的标量 reward。

信息更丰富的 full config 还适合非训练研究：分析工具调用序列、部分工具失败、judge/rule 分歧、目标工具遵从、领域混合，以及 SFT 投影丢失的信息。这些属于审计与构造用途，不应额外加入 training_use。

谨慎复用者应固定 HF revision 0df3cf3，维持 119,287 个 SFT 行与 1,527,259 条 full trajectory 的关联，并在可用时显式保留 subset_name、工具 schema、message、评审与 MCP metadata，同时把 irrelevance 与普通 episode 隔离。高保证复用还需要逐记录 lineage manifest、冻结 MCP 回放 fixture 或明确的 offline-only 定位、接受/拒绝 ledger、重复与 benchmark overlap 检查、逐组件权利审查和有文档的 PII 扫描。benchmark 增益应独立复现，不能用来替代上述数据检查。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the unique full-trajectory count at 1,527,259: Kimi-K2 518,516 + OSS 457,130 + Qwen3 551,613.
  • Interpret HF's 1,646,546 stored rows as the three full configurations plus a repeated 119,287-row SFT subset, not as independent trajectories.
  • Follow the five stages: MCP onboarding, task synthesis, Kimi-K2 task review, live rollout, then rule/target-tool/GPT-OSS-120B trajectory review and packaging.
  • Treat the feedback contract as mixed and full-episode/state-action supervision; real tool responses do not supply a task-general correctness predicate or scalar reward.
  • Restrict demonstrated training reuse to SFT on Qwen2.5-7B/14B/32B, and audit version binding, replay, rejection lineage, rights, PII, contamination, and tool-name matching before reuse.

• 唯一 full trajectory 总数应保持为 1,527,259：Kimi-K2 518,516 + OSS 457,130 + Qwen3 551,613。
  • HF 的 1,646,546 个存储行应解释为三个 full config 加上重复托管的 119,287 行 SFT 子集，而不是相互独立的轨迹。
  • 按五阶段阅读：MCP 接入、任务合成、Kimi-K2 任务评审、真实 rollout，再到规则/目标工具/GPT-OSS-120B 轨迹评审与打包。
  • 把反馈契约视为 mixed、full-episode/state-action supervision；真实工具响应没有提供通用任务正确性谓词或标量 reward。
  • 已展示的训练复用仅限 Qwen2.5-7B/14B/32B 的 SFT；复用前审计版本绑定、回放、拒绝 lineage、权利、PII、污染与工具名匹配。

value.html: Synthetic user tasks are generated from structured MCP server and tool specifications crawled from GitHub and Smithery. The paper filters an initial approximately 2,800 servers to 871 credential-free streamable-HTTP servers and then to 495 servers whose sampled tools function, and samples single-server, multi-server, and 25 featured-server task contexts with at most three target tools in the reported experiments.

value_zh.html: 合成用户任务由从 GitHub 与 Smithery 抓取的结构化 MCP 服务器与工具规格生成。论文将最初约 2,800 个服务器过滤为 871 个无需凭证的 streamable-HTTP 服务器，再过滤为 495 个其采样工具可运行的服务器，并在所报告实验中采样单服务器、多服务器与 25 个 featured-server 任务上下文，至多三个目标工具。

value.html: Historical tool/function responses returned by live remote MCP servers during collection. The release does not provide a normalized environment-state field, state delta, or immutable server snapshot.

value_zh.html: 采集期间由实时远程 MCP 服务器返回的历史 tool/function 回复。该发布不提供规范化的环境状态字段、状态增量或不可变服务器快照。

value.html: Tool calls declared in the row's system-level instruction/available_tools payload. Tasks may target one to three tools from one or multiple MCP servers, while the context can contain distractor tools or, for irrelevance examples, no suitable tool.

value_zh.html: 行内系统级 instruction/available_tools 载荷中声明的工具调用。任务可针对来自一个或多个 MCP 服务器的一至三个工具，而上下文可含干扰工具，或对无关样例不含合适工具。

value.html: A full-release row contains uuid, subset_name, serialized messages, question, serialized available_tools, target_tools, serialized question and response quality assessments, and serialized MCP/annotation metadata. Messages preserve the generator-native system/tool declarations, user turns, assistant tool calls, tool/function responses, and final assistant response. The SFT configuration is a reduced six-column view: uuid, subset_name, question, target_tools, tools, and messages.

value.html: Kimi-K2 assigns six 1-5 task ratings; public rules require a started agent, tool calls, at least one meaningful tool response, no assistant error marker, a non-empty final answer, and no exclamation marks; target-tool coverage and order are computed from tool names; GPT-OSS-120B rates response completeness and conciseness. These checks do not constitute a universal correctness verifier for the user's end goal.

value_zh.html: Kimi-K2 给出六项 1-5 任务评分；公开规则要求已启动的智能体、工具调用、至少一条有意义的工具回复、无助手错误标记、非空最终答案且无感叹号；目标工具覆盖与顺序由工具名计算；GPT-OSS-120B 评分回复完整性与简洁性。这些检查不构成对用户最终目标的通用正确性验证器。

value.html: Question-level reasoned 1-5 scores for tool-selection difficulty, uniqueness, question quality, scenario realism, verifiability, and stability; response-level reasoned 1-5 completeness and conciseness scores; desired-target-tool coverage in [0,1]; and Boolean order correctness. The SFT configuration omits these assessment columns after selection.

value_zh.html: 问题级带理由的 1-5 分数，覆盖工具选择难度、唯一性、问题质量、场景真实性、可核验性与稳定性；回复级带理由的 1-5 完整性与简洁性分数；期望目标工具覆盖在 [0,1]；以及布尔顺序正确性。SFT 配置在选择后省略这些评估列。

value.html: No single scalar environment reward or step reward is released. Multi-dimensional judge scores and rule/tool-coverage checks are annotations and selection signals.

value_zh.html: 未发布单一标量环境奖励或步骤奖励。多维评审分数与规则/工具覆盖检查为标注与选择信号。

value.html: No task-general terminal-success predicate is disclosed. A retained ordinary trajectory must satisfy the public rule filter and receive full-episode judge annotations; irrelevance examples are instead selected to make zero tool calls.

value_zh.html: 未披露任务通用的终局成功谓词。保留的普通轨迹必须满足公开规则过滤器并获得完整 episode 评审标注；无关样例则被选为进行零次工具调用。

value.html: GitHub/Smithery MCP specification -> accessibility and tool-function screening -> LLM task generation -> embedding deduplication and Kimi-K2 task annotation -> live MCP rollout by one of three teacher models through one of two frameworks -> rule filtering, target-tool checks, and GPT-OSS-120B response annotation -> generator-specific full configuration -> thresholded and category-rebalanced 119,287-row SFT configuration. Record-level production parameters and rejection lineage remain incomplete.

value_zh.html: GitHub/Smithery MCP 规格 -> 可访问性与工具功能筛查 -> LLM 任务生成 -> embedding 去重与 Kimi-K2 任务标注 -> 三个教师模型之一通过两个框架之一进行实时 MCP rollout -> 规则过滤、目标工具检查与 GPT-OSS-120B 回复标注 -> 生成器特定完整配置 -> 经阈值与类别再平衡的 119,287 行 SFT 配置。记录级生产参数与拒绝谱系仍不完整。

value.html: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, and Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct are the experimental SFT base models.

value_zh.html: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 为实验 SFT 基座模型。

value.html: GPT-OSS-120B, Kimi-K2, and Qwen3-32B generate agent trajectories. Kimi-K2 is also the task-quality annotator and GPT-OSS-120B is the response-quality judge.

value_zh.html: GPT-OSS-120B、Kimi-K2 与 Qwen3-32B 生成智能体轨迹。Kimi-K2 亦为任务质量标注器，GPT-OSS-120B 为回复质量评审。

value.html: Task generators are Mistral-Small, DevStral-Small, GPT-OSS, Kimi-K2, and Qwen3-32B; trajectory generators are GPT-OSS-120B, Kimi-K2, and Qwen3-32B using Qwen-Agent or OpenAI Agents.

value_zh.html: 任务生成器为 Mistral-Small、DevStral-Small、GPT-OSS、Kimi-K2 与 Qwen3-32B；轨迹生成器为使用 Qwen-Agent 或 OpenAI Agents 的 GPT-OSS-120B、Kimi-K2 与 Qwen3-32B。

value.html: MCP server metadata and machine-readable tool specifications crawled from GitHub and Smithery, sampled under single-server, multi-server, and featured-server strategies. Per-task source URL and specification commit are not normalized in the hosted top-level schema.

value_zh.html: 从 GitHub 与 Smithery 抓取的 MCP 服务器元数据与机器可读工具规格，在 single-server、multi-server 与 featured-server 策略下采样。逐任务来源 URL 与规格 commit 未在托管的顶层 schema 中规范化。

value.html: Core tasks are generated with one to three target tools; multi-server sampling can draw same-category, different-category, random, or featured combinations. Three post-core extensions create irrelevant, persona/constraint-diversified, and multi-turn tasks. The current public question generator supports random, uniform, power-law, and featured sampling, but exact historical mixture weights, seeds, and commands are unknown.

value_zh.html: 核心任务以一至三个目标工具生成；多服务器采样可抽取同类别、不同类别、随机或 featured 组合。三项核心后扩展创建无关、persona/约束多样化与多轮任务。当前公开问题生成器支持随机、均匀、幂律与 featured 采样，但精确历史混合权重、seeds 与命令未知。

value.html: 1,527,259 full trajectories across Kimi-K2 (518,516), OSS (457,130), and Qwen3 (551,613) hosted configurations. A separate 119,287-row SFT configuration is a selected subset and must not be added as new unique trajectories.

value_zh.html: 跨 Kimi-K2（518,516）、OSS（457,130）与 Qwen3（551,613）托管配置的 1,527,259 条完整轨迹。单独的 119,287 行 SFT 配置为选出的子集，不得作为新的独特轨迹相加。

value.html: Public generation scripts default to temperature 1.0 and top-p 1.0, but the paper does not confirm the production overrides or per-model decoding settings.

value_zh.html: 公开生成脚本默认为 temperature 1.0 与 top-p 1.0，但论文未确认生产覆盖或逐模型解码设置。

value.html: Qwen-Agent and OpenAI Agents connect to remote MCP servers. The multi-turn extension either splits a complex task into sequential subquestions or generates contextual follow-up queries and reruns the core generation/filtering pipeline.

value_zh.html: Qwen-Agent 与 OpenAI Agents 连接远程 MCP 服务器。多轮扩展或将复杂任务拆为顺序子问题，或生成上下文后续查询并重跑核心生成/过滤流水线。

value.html: SFT rows require question quality=5, scenario realism=5, completeness>=4, conciseness>=4, and desired-target-tool coverage=1.0, followed by category rebalancing. Rebalancing weights and an accepted/rejected row manifest are unknown.

value_zh.html: SFT 行要求 question quality=5、scenario realism=5、completeness>=4、conciseness>=4 以及 desired-target-tool coverage=1.0，随后进行类别再平衡。再平衡权重与接受/拒绝行清单未知。

value.html: Task rows receive Kimi-K2 ratings after formatting cleanup and embedding-based deduplication. Trajectories must satisfy rule checks for agent start, tool use, at least one meaningful tool response, assistant/error/final-message formatting, and then receive target-tool coverage/order plus GPT-OSS-120B completeness and conciseness annotations. Partial tool failures may remain when another tool call succeeds.

value_zh.html: 任务行在格式清理与基于 embedding 的去重后接受 Kimi-K2 评分。轨迹必须满足智能体启动、工具使用、至少一条有意义工具回复、助手/错误/最终消息格式的规则检查，然后接受目标工具覆盖/顺序以及 GPT-OSS-120B 完整性与简洁性标注。当另一次工具调用成功时，部分工具失败可能保留。

value.html: Public runners default to 32,768 maximum tokens and a 90-second per-item timeout; the OpenAI-agent runner defaults to ten turns. Exact production wall-clock, token, retry, and framework-specific budgets are unknown.

value_zh.html: 公开 runners 默认为 32,768 最大 tokens 与每条目 90 秒超时；OpenAI-agent runner 默认为十轮。精确生产 wall-clock、token、重试与框架特定预算未知。

value.html: Hermes tool-call template; learning rate 2e-5; two epochs; 8 or 64 H100 GPUs; per-device batch size 1; effective batch size 64; AdamW with beta=(0.9,0.999) and epsilon=1e-8; DeepSpeed ZeRO-3; maximum sequence length 32,768.

value_zh.html: Hermes 工具调用模板；学习率 2e-5；两个 epochs；8 或 64 张 H100 GPUs；逐设备 batch size 1；有效 batch size 64；AdamW 且 beta=(0.9,0.999) 与 epsilon=1e-8；DeepSpeed ZeRO-3；最大序列长度 32,768。

value.html: Synthetic tasks and trajectories across 495 community MCP servers and more than 2,000 tools. Full hosted partitions contain 518,516 Kimi-K2, 457,130 GPT-OSS, and 551,613 Qwen3 trajectories; the SFT subset contains about 28.3K core, 40K irrelevance, 15.8K diversified, and 35.2K multi-turn examples.

value_zh.html: 跨越 495 个社区 MCP 服务器与超过 2,000 个工具的合成任务与轨迹。完整托管分区含 518,516 条 Kimi-K2、457,130 条 GPT-OSS 与 551,613 条 Qwen3 轨迹；SFT 子集约含 28.3K 核心、40K 无关、15.8K 多样化与 35.2K 多轮样例。

value.html: All four hosted configurations expose only a train split. No public dev/test, hidden evaluation, or immutable rejected-sample partition is disclosed.

value_zh.html: 全部四个托管配置仅暴露 train 划分。未披露公开的 dev/test、隐藏评测或不可变拒绝样本分区。

value.html: The paper evaluates on BFCL V3, tau-bench, tau2-bench, and MCP-Universe but does not report task/text/tool overlap or model-exposure checks against those benchmarks, prior tool-use corpora, or pretraining data.

value_zh.html: 论文在 BFCL V3、tau-bench、tau2-bench 与 MCP-Universe 上评测，但未报告相对这些基准、先前工具使用语料或预训练数据的任务/文本/工具重叠或模型暴露检查。

value.html: unknown

value_zh.html: 未知

value.html: The release intentionally preserves partial-failure/error-handling episodes when at least one tool call yields a meaningful response; ordinary no-tool episodes, all-tool-failure episodes, assistant error-marker episodes, empty-final episodes, and other rule failures are filtered. Irrelevance examples deliberately retain zero-tool behavior under a special rule. Counts and records for rejected episodes are not released.

value_zh.html: 当至少一次工具调用产生有意义回复时，该发布有意保留部分失败/错误处理 episodes；普通无工具 episodes、全部工具失败 episodes、助手错误标记 episodes、empty-final episodes 与其他规则失败被过滤。无关样例在特殊规则下故意保留零工具行为。被拒绝 episodes 的计数与记录未发布。

items: Real tool execution is not equivalent to goal verification: the filters and judges can retain a plausible, complete-looking response whose tool outputs or final synthesis are factually wrong.
Kimi-K2 and GPT-OSS-120B judge labels can encode model bias; the task-judge comparison uses only 50 human-annotated examples and reports limited correlation.

Target-tool coverage and order use substring name matching in public code, which can collide across similar tool names and rewards compliance with seeded tools rather than discovery of an alternative valid workflow.
Partial tool failures are retained, while all-failure trajectories are removed; this supports some error-handling data but truncates the failure distribution and has no released rejection ledger.
Live community MCP endpoints, external information, and connection quality drift; historical messages are inspectable but exact environment replay is not.
The paper says collection occurred in June 2025, whereas the HF card says June through September 2025; per-row timestamps and the boundary between revisions are unavailable.
The current total of 1,646,546 hosted rows double-counts the 119,287-row SFT subset if interpreted as unique trajectories; the full generator partitions alone total the paper's 1,527,259.
All configurations are train-only and no decontamination or benchmark-overlap audit is disclosed, creating leakage and memorization risk for evaluation claims.
Apache-2.0 dataset metadata and MIT pipeline code do not by themselves establish reuse rights for every community-server specification and live third-party output.
No tagged end-to-end release pins paper, code, model endpoints, MCP services, dependency/runtime state, and dataset files; production settings may differ from current script defaults.
真实工具执行不等同于目标核验：过滤器与评审可保留看起来合理、完整但其工具输出或最终综合事实错误的回复。
Kimi-K2 与 GPT-OSS-120B 评审标签可编码模型偏差；任务评审比较仅使用 50 条人工标注样例，并报告有限相关。
目标工具覆盖与顺序在公开代码中使用子串名称匹配，可在相似工具名间碰撞，并奖励对种子工具的遵从而非发现替代有效工作流。
部分工具失败被保留，而全部失败轨迹被移除；这支持部分错误处理数据，但截断失败分布，且无已发布的拒绝账本。
实时社区 MCP 端点、外部信息与连接质量会漂移；历史 messages 可检视，但精确环境回放不可。
论文称采集发生于 2025 年 6 月，而 HF 卡片称 2025 年 6 月至 9 月；逐行时间戳与修订之间的边界不可得。
若将当前托管行总计 1,646,546 解释为独特轨迹，则会重复计算 119,287 行 SFT 子集；仅完整生成器分区合计即为论文的 1,527,259。
全部配置仅为 train，且未披露去污染或基准重叠审计，给评测主张带来泄漏与记忆风险。
Apache-2.0 数据集元数据与 MIT 流水线代码本身并不确立每一社区服务器规格与实时第三方输出的复用权利。
无带 tag 的端到端发布钉扎论文、代码、模型端点、MCP 服务、依赖/运行时状态与数据集文件；生产设置可能与当前脚本默认不同。

value.html: The HF card reports a best-effort PII scan using rule-based string replacements. Scanner rules, recall/precision, redaction manifests, consent, and residual third-party/sensitive-content audits are unknown.

value_zh.html: HF 卡片报告使用基于规则的字符串替换进行尽力而为的 PII 扫描。扫描器规则、召回/精确率、脱敏清单、同意与残余第三方/敏感内容审计未知。

value.html: The HF dataset declares Apache-2.0 and the code repository declares MIT. No per-server license/attribution manifest or rights analysis was verified for community MCP specifications, live tool outputs, third-party content, or generated trajectories, so the top-level declaration does not settle every upstream right.

value_zh.html: HF 数据集声明 Apache-2.0，代码仓库声明 MIT。未核验社区 MCP 规格、实时工具输出、第三方内容或生成轨迹的逐服务器许可/署名清单或权利分析，因此顶层声明并不解决每一项上游权利。

value.html: The stage-level pipeline is documented and code is public, but the hosted rows do not provide a complete immutable mapping to task-generator version, agent framework, model endpoint, seed, decoding parameters, retries, MCP server/source commit, endpoint state, collection timestamp, filters passed, or rejected siblings.

value_zh.html: 阶段级流水线已记录且代码公开，但托管行不提供到任务生成器版本、智能体框架、模型端点、seed、解码参数、重试、MCP 服务器/来源 commit、端点状态、采集时间戳、所通过过滤器或被拒绝兄弟项的完整不可变映射。
